printed_labels.text: ST BYTES TO SIBB PER ST CTR

review_notes.evidence: Own native complete page, twenty-seven block fields/pins, all individual AND-to-OR routes, upper and lower data turns, crossed rails and printed diamonds, parity input ownership and gate control turns, both R terminations, output labels and connector/footer print inspected. Native title is PER with a definite E bottom bar. Washed portions in AT/AU and several left signal labels are kept as replacement cells; no characters are supplied solely from A1 or related sheets.

review_notes.location: AT/AU washed fields and left labels
review_notes.evidence: Native white abrasion obscures AT unit/card characters, AU portion and printed grid letter, several GT and BYTE labels, and individual bit label glyphs. Original scan neighbors RT751 before and RT755 after; exact replacement cells retained.

AY B02 is fed by RS305AB4 PARITY00 through column160 from row34, AY D07 by BYTE00 through column161 from row33. AZ B04 has the direct RT625AB4 row31 input; AZ B10 is direct BYTE32 row35. Crossings at AZ B04 are unjoined.
AA and AU automatic candidate left edges selected input rails, not native gate borders. Excluded from affine fit after own native review; normal bank columns retained.
PER is directly readable with a definite E lower foot on this source, unlike the literal PFR of RT751/755.

validation.A1_original_native_snapshot_flags_scope: Original native-print/source-uncertainty flags retained unchanged. Current logical compatibility for source-derived repaired nodes is separately reported; direct source contradictions remain.
